title: PVP Hoplite Deluxe
description: This is the best texture pack for Hoplite, it contains all of the essential textures and more
body:
### **Phalanxian's Hoplite Texture Pack**
This Pack changes textures of diamond armour and tools, water and lava buckets, ores, GUI and HUD, golden apples, enderpearls and more.
### Features:
## Low Fire
So you can see even when you're on fire
## Low Shield
The shield doesn't take up your whole screen anymore
## Outlined Ores
You won't miss any diamonds anymore!
## Clear GUI 
Clearer Visibility when looting
And more
